title: VARIOUS LEGO
reason: Under-described: tub holds several built current-era LEGO models (Dobby, Mandrake-style plant, botanical flowers) plus booklets and loose bricks, which sell better sorted and split up.
findings: Clear plastic tub of mostly assembled modern LEGO plus loose bricks. Visible: a built Dobby the House-Elf figure (looks like Harry Potter set 76421), a built potted root-creature plant with big green leaves (Mandrake style), a brown tentacled creature model, a white and blue train, orange flower and green stem parts like the Botanical range, a chequerboard build, and a card box of loose bricks and flowers with a price sticker. Loose instruction booklets include Speed Champions 76921 (Audi S1 e-tron quattro race car) and 76914 (Ferrari 812 Competizione), a Lotus Evija booklet with the number partly hidden, and other booklets. No built Speed Champions cars, set boxes or minifigures can be seen, so those booklets may be orphaned. Quick web check on 19/10/2026: BrickEconomy lists a used 76421 Dobby at about US$30 to 41 (https://www.brickeconomy.com/set/76421-1/lego). The title undersells the lot: it is several current-era sets and parts, but completeness is unknown.
condition: Assembled and played-with, mixed loose bricks, booklets creased. Completeness of each set is unknown and there are no boxes. Missing, broken or non-LEGO pieces cannot be checked from the photos.
rescore_note: Several built current-era LEGO models (Dobby, a mandrake-style plant, a tentacled creature, a train, botanical flowers) plus loose bricks, and LEGO sells well; completeness is unknown, there are no boxes and the Speed Champions booklets look orphaned, so upper part of the $80 to 200 band. (no web price check)
